headline: Chris Young, Vertex CEO: A Fortt Knox Conversation
summary: Vertex CEO Chris Young told Jon Fortt tax compliance is being remade by AI, e-invoicing mandates and agentic commerce – but tax has to stay deterministic, so AI wraps the engines rather than replacing them. He's targeting $60–70M in savings to fund that shift. Young grew up working class on Cleveland's east side, a Great Migration family – father in autos, mother working three jobs – before Princeton and a career at AOL, McAfee and Microsoft.
